screen: Exclude if proxy factor(ED)/factor(last available price date) is missing or outside [1/1.4,1.4]. Proxy factor is company market capitalization divided by total shares of locally quoted classes divided by class adjusted close.
denominator: Last available shares outstanding at or before ED, lookback250 trading days.
local_diagnostic: Compare same proxy factor at AD minus120 calendar days and ED plus45 calendar days (nearest available trade boundaries); this is a wide snapshot-bound diagnostic, not exact fund-specific reporting dates. Never substitutes for corporate-action verification.
interpretation: A future-adjustment exclusion can be motivated by adjusted holdings vs historical shares units; it nevertheless causes historical attrition. Proxy is not an independently authenticated split record.
